units.source_text: 过了一段时间，信子想到自己的文学梦，于是在丈夫外出的时候，她便开始写一两个小时的文字。

en.t: After some time, Nobuko remembered her dream of literature, and when her husband was out, she began writing for an hour or two.

units.source_text: 丈夫得知这件事后，微笑的说“我的信子快要成为女作家了呀。”

en.t: When her husband learned of this, he smiled and said, "My Nobuko is about to become a woman writer."

units.source_text: 但是，虽然她很努力的思考创作，但是下笔却很艰难。

en.t: But although she thought very hard about what to create, putting words down on paper was extremely difficult.

units.source_text: 她经常会注意到，自己以手托腮，听着松林里的蝉鸣出神。

en.t: She would often notice herself resting her cheek on her hand, lost in thought as she listened to the cicadas in the pine grove.
